title: SynaptaHub Undetected, Weapon Mods, Kill All, No Slow, etc.
features:
UPDATED: 10/6/2026

NOTE: Get Defuser Has been patched (pretty sure) but everything else should work fine!
High UNC Executor Required: Madium, Velocity, Real, Potassium (Recommended), Volt a high UNC executor. If the script dosen't work tell me you're executor I'll see what I can do. I also have a log extracter script so if it dosen't work just tell me.

THIS WAS TESTED ON POTASSIUM!

🛡️ Protection & Safety
- Automatic anti‑cheat bypass (works silently in the background)
- Detects staff members and triggers a safe panic mode
- Prevents running multiple instances of the script
- Full panic button that instantly cleans up everything and restores normal game state

👥 Player ESP
- Box ESP – Draws a colored box around enemies
- Skeleton ESP – Lines connecting body joints (R6/R15)
- Dynamic Head ESP – Circle around the enemy's head
- Small Head ESP – Dot on the head for precise aiming
- Health Bars – Color‑coded bar showing remaining HP
- Text ESP – Shows player name, distance, and health
- Highlight ESP – Glow effect on enemies (toggleable)
- Adjustable text distance and size scaling

🛠️ Object ESP
- Gadget ESP – Highlights gadgets instead of boxes, with individual toggles for each gadget type (e.g., frag, claymore, medkit)
- Drone ESP – Highlights enemy drones and optionally shows owner
- Defuser ESP – Highlights the planted defuser
- Objective ESP – Highlights bomb sites
- 🔫 Weapon Mods & Rage Features
- Infinite Ammo
- No Recoil
- No Spread
- Instant ADS
- Fast Fire Rate
- Headshot Only
- No Barbwire Damage
- No Slow (removes slow effects)
- No Signal Jammer (allows drone use in jammed areas)
- Kill All – Instantly eliminates all enemies
- Plant Anywhere – Plant the defuser instantly as attacker
- Retrieve Defuser – Pick up a dropped defuser
- Defuse Defuser – Disable the enemy defuser as defender

⚡ Performance
- Potato Mode – Disables particles, shadows, and decals to boost FPS
- ESP Update Rate – Adjust how often ESP refreshes (frame skip)
- FPS Cap – Set a custom FPS limit (if supported)
- Smart distance and view culling to reduce lag

🎮 Quality of Life
- FOV Changer – Adjust field of view
- Walk Speed – Change movement speed
- Unlock Camera – Toggle third person / classic camera
- Auto Choose Attacker / Defender – Automatically select your character class
- Export System State – Copy debug information to clipboard
- Discord Link – Quick copy of the hub’s Discord invite
- Panic Button – Instantly disable everything and restore normal gameplay
